title: Knowledge Lifecycle Pipeline Design Complete + First Promotion Example
l2_insight: Knowledge moves through four tiers (T1→T2→T3→T4) with promotion checklists and condensation patterns at each boundary
summary: P7 Context has designed the complete T1→T2→T3→T4 knowledge lifecycle pipeline: promotion checklists, condensation patterns, broadcast triggers, and INDEX.yaml discovery format. Promoted Roc's convergence proof from workspace to knowledge/ as demonstration.
key_insights: Workspace (T1) → Knowledge (T2) → Soul (T3) → Fleet (T4) lifecycle pipeline
Promotion requires checklist verification before crossing each tier boundary
